sources.label: Official Reiss size guides (Women's clothing chart, cm; Women's international size conversions)

audit: Stored URL /p/size-guide now 404s; guide is at /size-guide. Was 5 letter rows (XS–XL, single UK sizes, S = UK 8–10). Official women's chart is per UK size, UK 4–18, with letter sizes covering two UK sizes each (XS 4/6, S 8/10, M 12/14, L 16/18), cm values as published by Reiss (inch originals in _in). Old M (UK 12) bust 90 → 94, waist 70 → 75, hips 95 → 101; old L (UK 14) bust 95 → 99, waist 75 → 80, hips 100 → 106; old XL (UK 16) bust 101 → 104, waist 81 → 85, hips 106 → 111. The old XL label was wrong: Reiss calls UK 16 'L' (XL is UK 20–22, which has a size conversion but no body measurements, so not included). US and EU from Reiss's own conversion table (UK 4 = US 0 = EU 32).
notes: UK sizing. Premium tailored brand. The official women's chart covers UK 4–18 (letter sizes span two UK sizes: XS 4–6, S 8–10, M 12–14, L 16–18). Suits and structured pieces are cut slim. Separate denim chart by waist size; petite pieces are shortened in length, not resized.
